title: C-17 drops off a mystery box at a guarded North Dakota hangar

tellings.quote: and he was talking about a situation in North Dakota where a C17 landed, they dropped off a box. It was this whole ordeal in the middle of the night.

plain: In 2012 a C-17, a large military cargo plane, is said to have landed in North Dakota in the middle of the night and dropped off a box at a heavily guarded hangar, with the suggestion that it held something recovered from a crash. A guest named Dylan Borland passes this on from a member of the military's security forces he calls Raven, who described "a situation in North Dakota where a C17 landed, they dropped off a box. It was this whole ordeal in the middle of the night." The telling does not say what was in the box.
